test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct Speech.

They said that they were supposed to arrive earlier.

options.text: They said, "We were supposed to arrive earlier."
They said, "We have to arrive earlier."
They said, "We are supposed to arrive earlier."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** They said that they were supposed to arrive earlier.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"they were supposed to arrive" becomes "We were supposed to arrive"**
 
 
• Pronoun "they" changes to "we" to match the perspective of the direct speakers.
 
• Verb tense "were supposed" remains unchanged as it reflects past obligation.
 
 
 
• **Quotation Marks:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed within double quotation marks.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech begins with a capital letter.
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, separated by a comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"They said, “We were supposed to arrive earlier.”"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "They said, ‘We should arrive earlier.’"

 
 
• Incorrect modal verb "should" changes the meaning from obligation to advice.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "They said, ‘We have to arrive earlier.’"
 
 
• Incorrect modal verb "have to" indicates present obligation, not past.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "They said, ‘We are supposed to arrive earlier.’"
 
 
• Incorrect verb tense "are supposed" changes the meaning to present obligation.
